constructions.title: What observing.py adds for the claims sweep: DCE's Tabel 3 parsed, marine-tagged bathing stations, and the boundary-test settings

dce_table3.models.is: Models listed in Tabel 3 of the pinned DCE report, as parsed by dce_table3(): one per list of selected variables, and refused unless, in each half of the table, the lists, the R2 values and the ja/nej entries of the systematic-deviation column come to the same count.

dce_table3.with_bv.is: Of those models, the ones whose selected variables include water-column stability (BV).

dce_table3.with_vind.is: Of those models, the ones whose selected variables include wind stress (vind).

dce_table3.with_nload.is: Of those models, the ones whose selected variables include nitrogen load (N-load).

dce_table3.with_pload.is: Of those models, the ones whose selected variables include phosphorus load (P-load).

n_bathing_marine.is: Stations of the national bathing layer whose water-body id is one of the marine water bodies of the VP3 layer.

sizes.irrelevant_area.is: The sum, in km2, of the stated areas of the marine water bodies typed `Ej relevant`.

coverage.n_matched.is: Polygons the name match counts as carrying a statistical model.

params.boundary_near_km.is: The distance, in km, within which stations either side of a water-body boundary are paired for the boundary test - a setting in observing.py.

params.boundary_min_pairs.is: The number of cross-boundary station pairs a water-body pair needs before it is tested - a setting in observing.py.

constructions.what: Counts read from the pinned DCE report's model table and from the national bathing and water-body layers, and two settings of the boundary test.
constructions.model: `dce_table3()` takes the text of Tabel 3 from the pinned DCE report and walks its tokens: a token made only of variable abbreviations starts or, after a trailing comma, continues one model's list; decimals no greater than one are R2 values; ja and nej are the systematic-deviation column. The three counts must agree in each half of the table. `main()` counts bathing stations whose `wbid` is a VP3 marine water body, and sums the areas typed `Ej relevant`. The boundary settings are constants in the script.
assumptions: The PDF text extraction keeps each model's variable list together and in order, so a list is not split or merged across models.
A decimal no greater than one in the table body is an R2 value; the deviation column holds percentages above one.

justified.text: The parse checks itself: three quantities that must each count the models once are taken independently and must agree in each half of the table, or the script refuses.
The counts of selected variables agree with those an earlier hand count of the same table gave for water-column stability and wind stress; the total of models does not, and the hand count is retired.

gaps: A model whose variable list the extraction broke across a line would be counted as two, and only the agreement with the R2 and ja/nej counts guards against it.
The boundary settings are chosen, not derived; other settings would test other pairs.
void_if: the DCE report is re-pinned with a different text extraction
the bathing or water-body layer is refetched and the script is not rerun
constructions.licenses: How many models DCE's Tabel 3 lists and how many select each variable; how many bathing stations carry a marine water-body id; how much of the sea the open-sea polygons hold.
constructions.not_licensed: Which variables matter in the sea, or anything about the models' quality.
